purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Suna East Form 34B final TOTAL row and preserve a genuine special-facility denominator gap without promotion.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (no third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact involved), then rotated 180 degrees (the portal-served scan for this constituency's second page is upside down) and re-cropped/upscaled around the TOTAL row for digit-level confirmation. This constituency's downloaded Form 34B is a 4-page document; page 2 is sheet 'FORM34B11', ending in the TOTAL row, and page 3 carries the Aggregate Results table and Voter Turn Out declaration box (source_image_sha256 d7b79d015adf27a7a9702d8f17fb4eda880f34afa3734f39f326e6d1c2613a6b), which independently corroborates the candidate totals and the combined turnout figure. The page header banner reads 'CON 255 12/12'. The portal only served this PDF after a home-page + set-election session handshake (id=5).

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row and Aggregate Results/Voter Turn Out integers were read directly from the rendered page images (the TOTAL-row page after 180-degree rotation to correct the scan's orientation). No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. Constituency identity (SUNA EAST, code 255) was read from the 'CON 255' banner marker printed on both reviewed pages and the Constituency Returning Officer's name/signature block (CLEMENT OSIEMO MOKOBO) on page 3 before this row was accepted.

registered_voters.note: The printed TOTAL row's Registered Voters figure is 54,495 (matching the page-3 Voter Turn Out declaration box exactly), which is 30 more than the governed P23 constituency denominator (54,465). The two rows immediately above TOTAL are '049292145110301 MIGORI WOMEN' (registered 6) and '049292145110401 MIGORI PRISON (B)' (registered 24) -- summing to exactly 30, the observed delta -- and their non-ward polling-station code prefix ('049292...') matches the recurring special-facility numbering pattern already documented elsewhere in this Atlas (e.g. Kiambu's '049292145105401 KIAMBU PRISON'). This is treated as the same genuine national-facility denominator gap, not a transcription error.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row, cross-checked against the page-3 Aggregate Results table (Valid Votes in Figure: 38,391 / 2,128 / 27 / 74) and the Voter Turn Out box ('Total number of voters who turned out to vote: 40,620').

row_reconciliation.governed_p23_registered_voters_source: KDA-VOTERS-CON-255-2022 (data/indicators/registry/observations.json), exact sum of official IEBC child ward rows

note: Total Valid Votes, Rejected Ballots and the four candidate cells are individually clear and internally reconcile on the printed TOTAL row and the separate Aggregate Results/Voter Turn Out declaration (candidate sum 40,620 = printed Total Valid Votes = the form's own declared 'Total number of voters who turned out to vote'). However, the row's own printed Registered Voters figure (54,495) does not exactly match the separately governed P23 registered-voter denominator for this constituency (54,465). The printed Form 34B total includes two special-facility polling stations with non-ward codes (MIGORI WOMEN and MIGORI PRISON (B), registered 6+24=30 -- exactly the observed delta), which are outside the ordinary ward-boundary polling-station set used to derive the governed ward-summed registered-voters denominator. This matches the recurring genuine prison/national-facility denominator gap documented elsewhere in this Atlas (e.g. Kiambu, Kapseret, Naivasha, Alego Usonga, Baringo Central, Matuga, Lamu West, Garissa Township, Kitui Central, Mwea) rather than a transcription error. Per the extraction contract's exact-reconciliation requirement for registered_voters, this row is preserved unresolved and no turnout observation may be promoted from this evidence until the denominator conflict is independently reconciled by the governed P23 registered-voters denominator process.
